key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:65C8
name: read_tile_byte_masked
description: Packs the two coordinate registers into a masked table index, reads one byte from that table, and returns the byte stored at the second base address plus that value. It is a two-level map cell lookup.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:65D4
name: read_tile_byte_unmasked
description: Packs the coordinate registers into a table index without masking the x part, reads one byte from the table, and returns the byte at the second base address plus that value. It performs the same kind of map cell lookup as its neighbours.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:65EC
name: read_tile_byte_alt_base
description: Performs the same packed-index table lookup as read_tile_byte_unmasked, but offsets the result from a third address register instead of the second.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6604
name: read_tile_byte_plus_base
description: Reads one byte from a packed-index table and returns the byte at the address formed by a base register plus that value. It is a map cell lookup that adds the value to a different base register.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:661C
name: advance_capped_counter_pair
description: Sets a flag and increments a primary counter, which saturates at 16. When the primary counter passes 16 it is clamped to 16 and a secondary counter is incremented, capped at 99.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:665E
name: decrement_counter_or_reset_state
description: Sets a flag and decrements a counter while it is non-zero. When the counter is already zero, it sets a state byte to 7 and loads default parameter values if the state was different.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:66BA
name: reset_state_and_parameters
description: Clears the primary counter, sets two related state bytes to 7, and loads default parameter values of 100 and -160 plus a computed base offset.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:66F2
name: find_table_entry_by_position
description: Returns early when the first routine reports the value five. Otherwise it scans a table of four-word entries for one whose key matches the position registers, and on a match sets a found flag and stores that entry's position and extra field.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:67A4
name: or_flags_reset_on_zero
description: Calls two routines and ORs their byte results. When both results are zero it sets the state byte to 3 and clears a related counter, then returns the combined value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:67DA
name: reset_state_unless_code_six
description: Calls a routine and, when its result is not six, calls a second routine. If that second result is also not six, it sets the state byte to 3 and clears a related counter.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:680A
name: update_state_from_flags
description: Updates a numeric state byte from a sequence of flag reads, moving between values 0 to 5 according to the flags and the current value. It returns the state combined with the last flag bits read.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:691A
name: or_two_routine_results
description: Calls two routines and returns the OR of their byte results. A leading comparison of two values eight apart can never be equal, so only the OR path is ever taken.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6940
name: poll_flags_in_sequence
description: Calls up to four routines in turn, continuing only while each returned value has its low bit set. It stores no values itself and returns nothing.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:698A
name: shift_param_on_double_flag
description: Calls two routines and, only when both results have their low bit set, returns the incoming parameter register shifted right by four bits. Otherwise it returns the result of the last call.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:69CE
name: reset_active_record_state
description: Clears several motion fields of the active record, sets its size field to 16, and clamps its extent against a limit derived from half of a stored value. It restores saved position values when the flag checks succeed, then clears the active record pointer.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6A70
name: activate_nearby_table_record
description: Searches a table of 12-halfword records and then a table of 46-halfword records for one near the current position. A match gets its flag set and its offsets stored, its type adjusted for specific values, and it is swapped into the last active slot.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6C74
name: release_or_reposition_record
description: When an active record exists and the global flag is set, it clears the record's fields and releases the pointer. Otherwise it stores a direction-dependent velocity value, releases the pointer, and sets the record's vertical position from a saved value minus 16.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6D10
name: probe_tiles_or_flush_queue
description: Skips work for four calls, then either checks two neighbouring map cells for a blocking flag and calls routines when it is set, or flushes the queued entries. Flushing waits for a hardware status bit before writing each start value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6DAE
name: claim_slot_and_dispatch_code
description: Claims a free six-byte slot for the given byte pointer and writes its code and position values, then waits for the blitter busy flag and writes a control word. It then reads a code byte from a second table and sets a mode variable or saves the current position depending on that code.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6F06
name: flush_queued_blit_entries
description: Walks a three-word entry table and, for each entry marked pending, clears its slot and toggles its flag. It waits for the blitter busy flag to clear before writing a start value to the control register for each one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:6FB4
name: set_trigger_code_in_window
description: Returns early when a flag is set or the position lies outside a 16-unit tile window on either axis. Inside the window it sets a trigger code to four, unless a mode value of eleven applies without a matching record type.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7028
name: map_input_to_mode
description: Maps an input byte to a mode value of one, two or three when its top bit is set. When the top bit is clear it sets the mode to zero and probes further routines, using a vertical threshold that depends on the current state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:70B4
name: advance_motion_and_animation
description: Counts down a timer, advances an animation index through a table, and applies the velocity values to the position with bounds clamps. It then switches between motion states based on flag reads, and the dump is truncated, so the later states are not covered.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7AAC
name: reset_global_word_block
description: Copies a block of sixteen words onto itself, which changes nothing, then zeroes the next sixteen words of the same global table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7AB0
name: reset_global_word_block
description: Copies a block of sixteen words onto itself, which changes nothing, then zeroes the next sixteen words of the same global table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7AB4
name: reset_global_word_block
description: Copies a block of sixteen words onto itself, which changes nothing, then zeroes the next sixteen words of the same global table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7AB8
name: reset_global_word_block
description: Copies a block of sixteen words onto itself, which changes nothing, then zeroes the next sixteen words of the same global table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7B16
name: read_little_endian_word
description: Reads two consecutive bytes from the given address and returns them combined as a little-endian sixteen-bit value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:7B38
name: load_level_tables_and_records
description: Copies three 256-byte tables from the source, remaps tile type codes, and fills the record table from packed 16-bit fields. It then reads scroll and boundary values, and the dump is truncated after the record setup.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8684
name: build_pointer_table_from_list
description: Walks a four-byte source list and, for each entry with a valid position value, stores a pointer and a byte value into a six-byte table entry. It also writes the byte into the cell that the pointer addresses.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:87C6
name: fill_counter_indicator_cells
description: Clears a flag and writes sequences of cell values derived from a counter, using one value for paired cells, another for a leftover odd cell, and a third for the remaining cells.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:88A2
name: update_scroll_offsets_from_input
description: Adjusts a speed offset from two input checks and clamps the horizontal position. When the mode allows, it computes horizontal and vertical scroll deltas toward a stored reference and applies them through calls to other routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8B6E
name: set_flag_bytes_from_routines
description: Clears a block of five flag bytes, then sets one to one when a routine returns non-zero. It sets that flag to two when either of two signed routine results is non-zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8C34
name: adjust_velocity_by_shift_step
description: Adds or subtracts a step of sixteen scaled by a shift value, depending on the direction mode, and clamps the result to the limit passed in.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8CB0
name: adjust_velocity_fixed_step
description: Adds or subtracts a fixed step of eight depending on the direction mode, and clamps the result to the limit passed in.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8D14
name: add_sixteen_clamped_to_limit
description: Adds sixteen to a stored value and clamps the result to the limit passed in.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8D3A
name: decay_velocity_toward_zero
description: Moves a velocity value toward zero by a shift-scaled step of twelve, clamping it so it never crosses zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8DA8
name: update_entry_screen_bounds
description: Looks up an entry in a 20-byte record table, computes its bounds from the current position and scroll offsets, and stores the type code. When the type code changes, it also calls a routine with the new bounds.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:8F8A
name: backup_record_tables
description: Copies a table of 92-byte records and a table of 24-byte records into their backup areas, element by element.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:900E
name: restore_record_tables_from_backup
description: Copies the backed-up 92-byte and 24-byte record tables back into the live tables and clears the active record pointer. It then sets the saved position on records of type 27 or 28 when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9050
name: restore_small_record_table
description: Copies the backed-up 24-byte record table back into the live table and clears the active record pointer. It then sets the saved position on records of type 27 or 28 when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:908E
name: apply_saved_positions_to_records
description: Clears the active record pointer and, when a flag is set, copies the saved position into each record of type 27 or 28 in the 24-byte record table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:90F8
name: reset_stage_display_and_state
description: Writes two text digits built from an index value and two text lookups into a buffer. It sets tile dimension values from a per-index table, resets the scroll position and record state, and sets a timer from a fixed constant minus a stored value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9376
name: reset_position_and_flags
description: Writes two formatted digits into a text buffer and loads a flag from a stored value. It then resets the position to the saved start values and clears the four-entry tables and flags.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9496
name: compute_scroll_targets_from_pending
description: Chooses scroll target values from pending values, or derives them from the current position clamped to a limit when the pending values are unset. It stores the targets, wraps the vertical target into a 192-unit band, and clears the sub-tile offsets.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9640
name: initialise_interrupt_registers
description: Writes disable-all masks to the interrupt control registers, clears two saved counters, and then writes a final mask that enables a few interrupt bits. Several library calls are made around these writes.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:96BA
name: restore_saved_interrupt_enable
description: Clears a flag and waits for a busy flag to clear before writing disable-all masks to the interrupt registers. It then re-enables the interrupt bits saved earlier.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:970E
name: find_four_char_name_index
description: Compares a four-byte name against a table of sixteen five-byte entries and stores the matching position plus one. It stores a sentinel value of 1000 when nothing matches or when the stored number equals fifteen.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:97C8
name: display_stage_text_and_wait
description: Fills a text buffer with dashes and formatted digits for the current index, passes it to output routines, and loops until an input routine reports a value. When the index is the sentinel, it shows a different message and sets the index to one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:994C
name: poll_input_codes_loop
description: Polls several input codes in a loop and calls follow-up routines for the matching codes. The loop continues until no further matching code is reported.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:99D0
name: allocate_and_release_chip_block
description: Allocates a 16 KB block with clear and chip-memory requirements through the exec library and stores its address. It then passes that address and size to the matching release call and records a fixed status value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9A2E
name: place_record_centred_at
description: Looks up a 20-byte record and offsets the given point by half the record's width and its height. It then passes the resulting rectangle and the record index to another routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9A9E
name: run_setup_then_halt_loop
description: When its argument is zero it writes an interrupt-bit mask, calls several routines, and makes a conditional call when a counter exceeds 58000. It ends in an endless loop, and it references a pattern file name in the data.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:9F62
name: load_assets_then_run_loop
description: Sets the table size constants, loads the named asset files with loading messages, and then runs the stage loop until the stage index reaches the sentinel value of 1000. The loop dispatches to the stage and menu routines on each pass.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:AB8E
name: resume_stage_state_dispatch
description: Clamps a horizontal target, copies a saved position into the current position, and resets the state code. It then enters a switch that dispatches on the state code, and the dump is a decompiled fragment with a truncated tail.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ABA6
name: run_stage_frame_loop
description: Clamps a horizontal target, copies a saved position into the current position, and resets the state code. It then runs the per-frame loop that dispatches on that state code.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ADB0
name: advance_entry_frame_index
description: Advances the frame index of an entry, remapping a few specific index values to their replacements. It then loads attribute values from tables into the entry's fields.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:AE92
name: update_entry_by_mode
description: Finds the table slot matching the entry's code and clears the entry if none matches. It then fills position and size fields according to the entry's mode value, halving and clamping some values, and several mode cases do nothing.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B450
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns at once, so it is an empty stub.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B4BC
name: find_overlap_and_remap_entry
description: Scans the entry table for a live, unoccupied entry that overlaps the given area. When one is found it remaps that entry's type code and adjusts its vertical position, then updates the given entry's vertical speed from the flag bits of both entries.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B59E
name: step_entry_animation_state
description: Steps an entry's state code through a short sequence of values and advances its frame counter. It sets a flag bit when a new state begins and resets the state when the counter passes 200 or reaches its upper limit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B6E4
name: trigger_mode_on_entry_overlap
description: When a flag bit is clear, tests whether the entry overlaps a window around the current position. On overlap it sets two mode values to three, sets a timer, and clears a speed value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B762
name: check_entry_rectangles_overlap
description: Returns one when the rectangle of one entry overlaps the rectangle of another on both axes, otherwise zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B7B4
name: process_entry_collision_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of entry pointers and, for each entry with its flag bit set, tests the entries in its linked sub-list. On a hit it negates the velocity of the sub-entry, updates the entry's flags, and clears its speed fields.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:B8AA
name: update_entries_and_check_contact
description: Updates every active entry for this frame by moving it relative to the scroll offset. When an entry overlaps the current position, it either flips its paired type code or sets a mode value, and the dump is truncated before the end.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:BEFE
name: add_entry_to_free_slot
description: When an entry has its flag bit set and the other bit clear, it places a new entry of type seventeen at the given position in the first free slot of a four-slot table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:BF3E
name: animate_four_slot_entries
description: For each active entry in a four-slot table, clears its pending flag, looks up its data pointer, and calls a routine. It advances the entry's type code every fourth frame and wraps it after twenty.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:BFD4
name: move_oscillating_entries
description: Moves each active entry in a table by its own speed in one of four directions, depending on its mode. Oscillating entries flip direction after a set number of steps, and an entry overlapping the current position snaps the position to its edge.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C160
name: copy_constant_word_into_slot
description: Copies a constant word from a fixed data location into a second fixed location, then returns.

name: copy_constant_word_into_slot

name: store_constant_longword_pairs
description: Stores fixed longword constants of 1628 and minus two into four consecutive data slots.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C1A6
name: build_display_list_buffer
description: Selects one of two display list buffers and fills it with address and value pairs taken from the current state fields, including a computed address. When that computed value is out of range, it writes a fixed terminator pair instead.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C35C
name: fill_column_pattern_buffers
description: Fills 176 entries in both display buffers with pattern words taken from a sequence counter and a per-mode lookup table. In a non-zero mode, when the second routine returns five, it writes an extra pattern word.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C554
name: fade_palette_by_steps
description: Repeats sixteen times: reduces each 4-bit component of 32 palette words by one step, applies the same step to the display buffer words, and then waits for a flag before continuing.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C760
name: clear_display_buffers
description: Zeroes two buffers of 8820 longwords each and a table of 336 words.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C7B2
name: halt_in_endless_loop
description: Makes one routine call and then loops forever, so it never returns.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C866
name: write_display_header_constants
description: Writes a series of fixed header words into the same offsets of both display buffers, with the final word taken from a stored value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:C976
name: clear_display_header_words
description: Writes a value of 384 into a set of header words in both display buffers and clears the word that follows each one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:CA6E
name: setup_display_buffers_and_copper
description: Allocates chip-memory buffers through the exec library, builds a 256-entry bit-reversal table, and sets up the display data and copper list registers. The dump is truncated, so the final register setup is partly missing.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:DBE8
name: lookup_range_table_value
description: Scans a table of three-word entries and returns the value of the last entry whose low-to-high range contains the parameter. It returns a default of 1000 when no entry's range matches.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:DC6A
name: set_entry_field_from_code
description: Looks up a code value and sets one entry field to a constant chosen by that code. For a specific set of codes it also sets a flag bit in another field.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:DDBC
name: sum_entry_span_sizes
description: For every table entry matching the parameter, adds a scaled size for each index in its range, computed from stored width and height values. It returns twice the total.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:DECA
name: mark_entry_range_flags
description: For every table entry matching the parameter, sets a flag word to one across the index range that entry covers.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:DF66
name: rebuild_active_entry_set
description: Rebuilds the set of active entries from the entry table by marking those in range and dropping any that exceed a size budget. It then clears a block of 300 words and loads the marked entries, and its text references name two sprite files.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E188
name: start_timed_mode_with_velocity
description: Sets two timers to 100 and 200, sets two mode values to three, and clears a flag. It stores a velocity from the input, negated when the horizontal position is less than the second parameter, then calls two routines and sets a status value of five.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E1DC
name: check_entry_hit_window
description: When two timers are zero, it picks a window height from the current mode and tests whether the entry lies in a window around the current position. On overlap it clears the entry's type and sets a counter to 28 before calling a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E27C
name: update_four_slot_positions
description: Updates four slots of a 12-halfword table by adding their velocity to the position. It bumps a counter for small non-zero speeds, looks up each slot's data pointer, and clears any slot whose routine reports zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E33E
name: has_free_four_slot
description: Returns one when any of the four slots in the table has a zero type code, otherwise zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E352
name: find_next_nonzero_record
description: Scans forward through 12-halfword records from the current pointer and returns one at the first non-zero record. It returns zero when the records run out.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E362
name: initialise_motion_record
description: Fills a motion record from the entry's data: a frame value and a vertical offset from the data block, a horizontal speed of eleven toward or away from the current position, and a zero vertical speed. It sets a status value of four.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E3B0
name: store_frame_and_position_record
description: Stores a frame number derived from the low 13 bits of a value minus 29, followed by the position words. It then sets two trailing fields to zero and one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E3CE
name: set_speed_toward_position
description: Sets a speed field from a byte in the entry, negated when the given horizontal value is left of the current horizontal position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E3E6
name: offset_x_by_speed_sign
description: Returns the given horizontal value shifted sixteen units backward when the entry's speed is non-negative, and forward when it is negative.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E3F8
name: set_speed_sign_from_position
description: Makes the entry's speed positive, then negates it when the given horizontal value is less than a stored position value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E412
name: reverse_speed_beyond_range
description: Reverses an entry's horizontal speed when it moves beyond its allowed range from a reference point. In its other states it sets a fixed vertical speed, advances a state code, or registers the entry in a list, depending on its flags.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E44A
name: steer_toward_current_position
description: Sets the entry's direction from the current horizontal position, then counts down a timer. When the timer expires and the entry is close enough, it sets a fixed timer and calls routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E476
name: steer_direction_with_countdown
description: Sets the entry's direction from the current horizontal position, then counts down a timer. When the timer expires and the entry is within range, it sets a fixed timer and calls a routine, then returns a status value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E4BC
name: trigger_when_within_range
description: When the given horizontal value lies left of the current horizontal position and within a stored distance, it sets a timer to thirty and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E4EA
name: tick_timer_and_fire_actions
description: Decrements a timer field and, when a flag bit is set, advances a 32-bit counter. It calls routines on that counter and resets the timer when it runs out.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E510
name: run_enemy_patrol_state_machine
description: Runs a movement routine for an entry with active states that move it and reverse its direction on a counted schedule. When idle it starts a count once the entry is in range, and entries in the other flag state are placed in a free list or have a timer ticked.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E556
name: start_countdown_on_range
description: When the entry is within range of a reference point and its flag is set, it increments a counter. It computes the smallest count whose running total reaches a limit, stores its negative as a speed, and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E59C
name: step_reversing_movement
description: Advances a counter-based movement cycle for an entry in state one, flipping its direction when the counter reaches its limit. In state two it calls routines once the counter passes its limit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E5EE
name: finish_state_two_cycle
description: In state two, advances a counter and, once it passes a limit, resets the state to zero and calls two routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E61E
name: run_approach_attack_states
description: Runs a three-state routine: in state zero it starts when the entry is within a window of the current horizontal position, and in state one it reverses direction once the entry moves beyond its range. The final state resets the entry, and the states of the other flag set are handled separately.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E66E
name: reverse_at_limit_or_reset
description: When the given state code is one, reverses the entry's speed once its position moves beyond a set distance from its reference, then advances the state. Otherwise, when the position reaches its end point, it calls two routines and resets the state to zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E696
name: reset_state_at_end_point
description: When the entry reaches its end position, it calls two routines and resets its state to zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E6AE
name: run_chase_state_machine
description: Runs a state machine for an entry: in state zero it starts a pursuit when the entry comes within a distance of the current position, and in state one it steers toward that position. State two resets to zero when the entry leaves a window, and state three returns to state one when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E704
name: run_chase_state_dispatch
description: Dispatches on a state code passed in a register: state two resets to zero outside a window, and state three moves to state one when a flag is set. Other codes count a timer and run the checks that set the next state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E732
name: update_patrol_and_range_state
description: Reverses the entry's speed when its flag bit is set, moves its position, and checks whether the entry is within range of the current position. It sets the state code to two when the entry is outside range, or to three when it is close while in state one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E796
name: trigger_state_three_in_range
description: When the entry is in state one and within a horizontal range and a vertical distance of nine of the current position, it sets its state to three and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E7D4
name: dispatch_chase_states_two_three
description: Handles state codes two and three: state two resets to zero when the entry leaves a window, and state three counts a timer and runs the chase checks. Those checks set the next state, or set state one when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E81C
name: run_chase_state_three
description: Handles state three by counting a timer and running the chase checks, which set the next state to one, two or three. It moves back to state one when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E834
name: run_three_state_patrol
description: Runs a three-state patrol: from idle it starts when the entry is near the current position, and in the moving state it counts and reverses direction. It changes state when the entry moves far from the position, and the final state returns to idle when the entry leaves a window.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E888
name: step_patrol_or_reset_state
description: When the given state is one, counts and reverses the entry's direction, then sets state two once it moves far from the current position. For other states it resets to zero when the entry leaves a window.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E8B4
name: reverse_on_far_distance
description: Reverses the entry's speed when its flag bit is set, moves its position, and sets state two when it ends up more than 640 units from the current position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E904
name: reset_state_outside_window
description: Resets the entry's state to zero and calls a routine when the entry leaves a window around the current position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E946
name: run_detect_and_pursue_states
description: Runs a state machine: in state zero it starts when the entry is near the current position, and in state one it counts and reverses direction. It moves to state two when the entry moves far away, and state two returns to state zero outside a window.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E996
name: step_pursuit_states_one_two
description: Handles state one, which counts and reverses direction and moves to state two when the entry is far, and state two, which returns to state zero outside a window. Otherwise it sets state one and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:E9D6
name: flip_speed_and_flag_far
description: Counts a value, reverses the entry's speed when its flag bit is set, and moves its position. It sets state two when the entry ends up more than 640 units from the current position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EA2A
name: dispatch_window_or_arm_state
description: Handles state code two by resetting the state to zero when the entry leaves a window. Other codes adjust a counter and set the state to one when the entry's flag bits call for it.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EA72
name: arm_state_from_flags
description: Sets the state to one when the entry's flag bits call for it, adjusting a counter first, and returns the result of a routine. It returns zero when neither flag applies.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EA8E
name: arm_state_one_with_counter
description: Adjusts a counter field of the entry by minus two, sets its state to one, and calls routines around those steps.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EAA6
name: run_four_state_patrol
description: Runs a patrol state machine: in state zero it starts when the entry comes close to the current position, and in state one it moves to state two or back to zero depending on distance. In state two it counts and reverses direction and moves to state three when far, and the default branch returns to state zero when the entry leaves a window.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EAFE
name: step_patrol_state_dispatch
description: Dispatches on a state code: code one returns to state zero when the entry is far and moves to state two when it is close, code two reverses direction and moves to state three when it is far, and other codes return to state zero outside a window.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EB42
name: reset_state_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then resets the entry's state to zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EB4C
name: step_patrol_state_two
description: For state two, reverses direction and moves to state three when the entry is far from the current position. For other codes it resets the state to zero when the entry leaves a window.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EBA6
name: reset_state_outside_small_window
description: Resets the entry's state to zero and calls routines when the entry leaves a smaller window around the current position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EBEC
name: run_timed_patrol_states
description: Runs a timed patrol state machine: in state zero it starts when the entry is near the current position, and in state one it reverses direction when the entry moves away. It moves to state three when the entry is close, and the higher states count a timer before setting the next state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EC3C
name: reset_state_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then resets the entry's state to zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EC46
name: dispatch_timed_patrol_states
description: Dispatches on a state code: code one reverses direction and moves to state three when the entry is close, and code two resets to zero when the entry leaves a window. Other codes count a value and set state one when a flag bit is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ECA2
name: count_down_into_state_three
description: Decrements a counter in the entry and, when it goes negative and the entry is close enough, sets its state to three and resets the counter to twenty.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ECD8
name: dispatch_window_or_flag_arm
description: Handles state code two by resetting to zero outside a window. For other codes it adds four to a counter and sets the state to one when a flag bit is set, returning the result of a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ED20
name: arm_state_with_counter_step
description: When the entry's flag bit is set, adds four to a counter, calls routines, sets the state to one, and returns the result of a routine. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ED42
name: run_four_phase_timer_cycle
description: Runs a four-phase cycle driven by counters: state zero records a value and moves to state one, state one counts down to state two, and state two advances until a position check passes and moves to state three. The final phase counts down back to state zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ED66
name: step_four_phase_timer_cycle
description: Handles states one, two and three of the four-phase cycle: state one counts down to state two, state two advances until a position check passes and moves to state three, and state three counts down back to state zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:ED7E
name: step_phase_two_or_three
description: Handles states two and three of the timer cycle: state two moves to state three once a position check passes, and state three counts a byte down to state zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EDA8
name: count_down_phase_to_zero
description: Decrements a phase byte in the entry and sets its state to zero when it reaches zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EDB4
name: run_timed_attack_cycle

name: step_timed_attack_states

name: step_timed_state_two_zero
description: Handles state code two of the timed cycle by counting up past ten to move to state three. For other codes it counts down and returns to state zero when the counter reaches zero.

name: store_value_plus_one_state
description: Stores the given value plus one in the entry's state field, then clears that state when the entry's flag bit is clear.

name: defer_entry_or_count_timer
description: When the entry's speed field is non-zero, it appends the entry to a pending list and sets its flag bit. Otherwise it adds sixteen to a timer and resets the state once the timer reaches its limit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][h chrome]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][h Chrome].adf:main:3:EFDA

name: rewind_list_cursor_and_flag
